name: k2-greenhouse-plus
title: Krastorio 2 Greenhouse + Wood Pyrolysis
author: ZarSasha
description: Easily grow wood in a greenhouse and convert it to coal and oil through wood pyrolysis. Contains an option for unlocking Coal Liquefaction early, as well as for growing several Gleba crops in their own greenhouses. Graphical assets were borrowed from "Krastorio 2" by raiguard.
